sentences.text: Mum and Dad went to a car boot sale.
The children looked at the dinghy.
Dad pumped it up but it went down again.
She put a patch on it.
Dad put the dinghy on the car.
They took a picnic and went to the river.
Mum and Dad had a good idea.
They found a good spot for the picnic.
It was time for the picnic.
Mum and Dad put the rug down and got the picnic out.
Floppy ran out of the water.
Biff and Chip watched the boats go by.
“I wish we could go on a big boat,” she said.
It was time to go home.
“My boat is in danger,” called a lady.
Mum put the dinghy in the river.
Mum climbed on to the boat.
Dad let go of the dinghy rope.
The dinghy went over the weir.
“I will lend you my boat to say thank you,” she said.
The family had a holiday on the boat.
